_meta.scenario: Service quality dispute — customer fled without paying and is alleging poor service (rude driver behavior, unsafe driving, unclean vehicle etc.) to justify non-payment. Admin marks trip as dispute to trigger investigation before any resolution or refund.
_meta.note: Use 'service' dispute_type when the grievance is about driver behavior or trip quality, not the fare amount.

reason: Customer complaint about driver behavior. Left without paying remaining balance.

dispute_detail.reason: Customer alleged driver was rude and drove rashly. Customer left the vehicle before destination without paying. Driver denies the allegations.

details.customer_complaint: Driver was rude and refused to follow route instructions.
details.driver_version: Customer demanded multiple route changes and then refused to pay.
